mechanism_narrative: A sustained CPIAUCSL above 240 signals persistent inflationary pressures that force the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 240, contradicting the negative return prediction.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tightening labor market that accelerates wage growth and inflation, triggering Federal Reserve rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 4.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based consumer demand slowdown, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both down >2% from prior month) fails to produce negative SPX 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (Fed rate hikes), S&P 500 forward returns turn negative due to higher discount rates and reduced corporate borrowing capacity, with effects materializing over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: During periods classified as monetary tightening cycles, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing output and supply chain stress, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO declines, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 3.0% indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate an extremely tight labor market that drives wage inflation and forces Fed policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously (both changes >0.5% in absolute value), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) serves as a leading indicator of weakening consumer demand, reducing retail activity and corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST declines, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
